FixedPoseMotion.description: Hold the named part at its matching current root pose; never teleport it.

ItemSlotAssignment.description: Explicit snapshot display placement; never business capacity or permanent occupancy.

JobExecutionRef.description: Frozen execution identity; operation/module identity is not device identity.

LocalContactAllowance.description: Local panel-face patches, never an exemption for an entire object pair.

PhaseMaterialFlow.description:
Explicit physical effects of phases on one preserved main item and its
consumed auxiliary materials. Absent on existing operation definitions.

PhaseWorkInterval.description: Positive, half-open effective work, excluding waiting and calendar pauses.

interval_end_causes.description: One declared end cause per interval, in the same ordinal order.
